sloka: स शिरः सशिरस्त्राणं श्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम्।प्रमथ्येन्द्रजितः कायात् पातयामास भूतले ।। ६.९१.७४ ।।
transliteration: sa śiraḥ saśirastrāṇaṁ śrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam।pramathyendrajitaḥ kāyāt pātayāmāsa bhūtale ।। 6.91.74 ।।

translations.english: Prosperous Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies, aiming at Indrajith's head shining with earrings belonging to the head severed from the body, it fell on ground.
